title: Prepare recovery from a deleted working directory
description: Replay prepare on a remote slot while the operator tmux server retains a deleted cwd. Set FARMSLOT_GATEWAY and FARMSLOT_CWD_PROOF_RUN_ID. Verifies the completed run through the live gateway and its actual fixture-copy log. Separate shell regressions exercise deleted inherited cwd and reject a missing target before hooks run.

live-prepare.intent: Read the replayed production run through run.get and verify prepare completed and fresh run-specific logs prove fixture files were copied.

directory-regressions.intent: Exercise a deleted inherited cwd and a missing requested directory in real child processes, including sentinel and hook execution checks.

replay-recovery.intent: Through run.create and run.replayStep, prove a missing-simulator failure retries without assuming a branch exists, preserves committed and dirty work on later retries, and blocks a lost previously established branch. Temporary slots, projects, runs and Git repos are cleaned up.
